title: Reports
subtitle: Every report BSDC issues carries an id, the instant it was generated, a SHA-256 hash of its own contents and a URL anybody can check it at.
registered: Registered — it can be checked by anyone
notRegistered: Not registered yet — the device could not reach the server, so it cannot be checked until it syncs
notAllowed: Your role cannot issue this report.
noCrypto: This browser does not expose SHA-256, so no report can be issued with a truthful integrity hash.

error.default: The report could not be issued.
error.BSDC-REPORT-001: The numbers could not be counted. Try again once the data has loaded.
error.BSDC-REPORT-002: The document could not be built.
error.BSDC-REPORT-003: This browser does not expose SHA-256, so no truthful hash can be printed.

verify.title: Check a report
verify.subtitle: Paste the report id, or the whole verification URL, and the hash printed underneath it.
verify.hashHint: Sixty-four hexadecimal characters, printed on the document.
